scenarios.name: S01_base_autosizing
scenarios.exercises: reference; DSCR pinned 1.20; debt repaid by L68

scenarios.name: S02_manual_small_debt
scenarios.description: Manual mode, small 3M debt — everything clears comfortably.
scenarios.exercises: low leverage; distributions early and large

scenarios.name: S03_manual_40M_unpaid
scenarios.description: Manual 40M — debt not extinguished at maturity (UNPAID).
scenarios.exercises: debt NOT extinguished at L68 -> row93 UNPAID

scenarios.name: S04_manual_60M_deferred
scenarios.description: Manual 60M — interest exceeds CFADS, deferred interest builds.
scenarios.exercises: interest>CFADS -> deferred interest builds (row89>0); DSRA draw

scenarios.name: S05_manual_48M_dsra_draw
scenarios.description: Manual 48M — DSRA drawn to top up interest in stress years.
scenarios.exercises: DSRA drawn to top up interest in stress years (row83>0)

scenarios.name: S06_hm_peak_mra_draw
scenarios.description: HM peak 3.5M — current cash short in peak years, MRA drawn to pay HM (no UNPAID).
scenarios.exercises: HM peak -> MRA drawn to pay HM (row98>0), no UNPAID

scenarios.name: S07_hm_extreme_unpaid
scenarios.description: HM peak 12M — even MRA insufficient (HM UNPAID).

scenarios.name: S08_high_dscr_target
scenarios.description: DSCR target 1.5 — tighter sculpting, later distributions.
scenarios.exercises: DSCR target 1.5 -> tighter sculpt, later distributions

scenarios.name: S10_mra_coefs_high
scenarios.exercises: MRA over-funded -> larger MRA balances, more lock-up

scenarios.name: S11_high_llcr_lockup
scenarios.description: LLCR lock-up threshold 1.35 (above base LLCR) — distributions locked more often.
scenarios.exercises: LLCR test blocks distributions early -> first distrib delayed to ~p13

scenarios.name: S12_high_dscr_lockup
scenarios.description: DSCR lock-up threshold 1.25 (above base DSCR 1.20) — distributions locked, treasury grows.
scenarios.exercises: DSCR test (1.25>1.20) blocks distributions until debt shrinks -> first distrib ~p21, treasury peaks ~8.5M

scenarios.name: S14_short_duration
scenarios.exercises: 10y window, 20M -> amortisation concentrated, UNPAID if unserviceable

scenarios.name: S15_low_tariff
scenarios.description: Low tariff 0.08 — CFADS strained, DSCR under pressure.
scenarios.exercises: low tariff -> CFADS strained, small deferred/DSRA draw
